svg.desc: Lake Tahoe depth layers. Depths in feet below 1,899 m (6,230 ft) lake level, 1998 survey. Not for navigation. Data: U.S. Geological Survey, Gardner et al. (1999), Lake Tahoe multibeam bathymetry, 10 m grid (USGS DDS-55). Layer 0 = shoreline; layer k = water deeper than the listed depth. Cut each layer from 3 mm stock and stack. Units: millimetres (1 user unit = 1 mm). One stroke colour per layer; every coloured line is a cut, the black text is the optional engrave line. Specks under 1/4 x 1/4 in removed for cutting.

g.text: Lake Tahoe · water deeper than 300, 780, 1,200, 1,420, 1,480 and 1,560 ft · USGS 1998 survey · Not for navigation
